price_unit: one fixed physical unit in one currency
analysis_target: retrospective common month price movement after allowing product-specific persistent price levels and supplier-specific quote levels
model_assumption: a product keeps its persistent price level over this six-month window; common month movement is shared; disturbances may depend within each supplier trajectory; all suppliers are observed in all six months
replacement_semantics: same family indicates replacement relationship only, not equal quality or equal price; observed overlap is evidence used to separate product level from month movement
uncertainty: resample or delete entire supplier trajectories; record disconnected/unidentified replicates and effective support; do not impute a bridge or silently discard failures
output: index normalized to 100 in base month; interval or explicit insufficient-support status; bridge sensitivity and observational identification limits
scope: one interpretable estimation approach; no forecasting, hedonic covariate model or automatic product matching
